The [Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator](/waist-to-height-ratio-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Compare waist circumference with height using the same units. Enter your waist and height and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Compare waist circumference with height using the same units. This free online waist-to-height ratio calculator gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator

Start by entering your waist (cm), then entering your height (cm). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your waist (cm).
2. Enter your height (cm).
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

WHtR = waist ÷ height. Measure both in the same units.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator](/waist-to-height-ratio-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. An 85 cm waist at 178 cm tall gives 0.478. Try the same figures in the [Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator](/waist-to-height-ratio-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Waist: 85 cm, Height: 178 cm), the [Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator](/waist-to-height-ratio-calculator) returns Waist-to-height ratio: 0.478, Waist as % of height: 47.8%, General guide: Below 0.5. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. - Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.
